newsitem.title: USA: Einstein/Noah Bagel target of lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Einstein/Noah Bagel target of lawsuit.

text.p: Plaintiff attorneys said late Friday, after the market closed, that they have begun a class action in the U.S. District Court for the District of Colorado charging Einstein Noah Bagel Corp with violations of the federal securities laws.

In a press release, Hagens & Berman PS said it and two other law firms are representing purchasers of Einstein Noah stock during the period from Einstein's initial public offering of stock on August 2, 1996 through July 15, 1997.
The complaint alleges that Einstein failed to recognize in its financial statements substantial losses which were incurred throughout its retail outlets.
An Einstein Noah spokeswoman was not immediately available for comment.
